Effective September 28, 2003, the European Aviation Safety Agency (EASA) began oversight of this product under their Type Certificate Number A.022 on behalf of Austria. Effective November 15th, 2017 this type certificate was transferred to Diamond Aircraft Industries in Canada under the oversight of Transport Canada Civil Aviation (TCCA).
